boundary: Two already exposed natural base tasks only; removed variants are development interventions, not additional D0/Discovery samples. No protected tasks, code generation, outcomes, Pair or manuscript changes.
comparison: Previous candidate-local-natural remains frozen; these repeated exposed tasks diagnose interface behavior, not reliability or unseen transfer.
evaluation: Separate proposal/review, graph construction/repair, candidate state, local semantic review, renderer and independent verifier. Source audit checks original non-target behavior, shared support, condition/order preservation and ambiguity. Approval is not gold; all failures/unknowns retained. Inverse ADD is the same paired source contrast, not an independent natural task. No population reliability estimate or security effect claim.
implementation_note: Working source archive includes the default candidate background interface repair; archive is authoritative.
model: Fresh inherited Codex contexts; exact model snapshot and seed unavailable.
procedure: One default full candidate proposal per task and one existing candidate semantic review for every proposed factor. Follow only the predeclared original requirement into editing; preserve all other decisions and accepted catalog factors. One catalog shared by fresh original and deleted-source construction. Per arm use existing extraction, at most one mechanical repair, one ordinary review, at most one local patch and one scope assessment. If the named factor is present/absent with usable comparison scopes, one paired source-support review supplies correspondence and local support; execute REMOVE and inverse ADD plus independent replay. No manual replacement judgments, semantic resampling, amended inputs or gate relaxation after responses. Stop dependent work at failed prerequisites; record every failure.
purpose: Test default candidate interface with immutable complete policy bindings and separately cited background on the two previously exposed natural tasks, then execute downstream fresh construction and actual edits if prerequisites pass.
